summary: @or-sdk/deployer preinstall downloads Bun runtime and auto-executes an obfuscated bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle carrying obfuscator.io-style artifacts (string-array rotation via `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, renamed identifiers, and a 1000+ entry opaque literal payload table) whose contents cannot be inspected. The package advertises itself as a small REST SDK (activate/deactivate flows, fetch logs) and its `src/` and `dist/` TypeScript output is ordinary and unobfuscated; only the install-time script uses obfuscator.io-renamed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x24db8d`) for its `fs`/`https`/`os` handles, and the executed `math_init.js` name has no relation to the SDK's functionality. The `@or-sdk/*` scope and internal `gitlab.internal.onereach.io` references in the CHANGELOG are consistent with a hijacked or typosquatted republish of a legitimate internal SDK with an alternate-runtime dropper appended. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute a hidden sibling bundle bypasses Node-based install scanners; the Bun-runtime fetch is from an official project domain but the code it is used to execute is the package's own opaque, obfuscated blob unrelated to the advertised SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
